answer: Require every agent to lock a slashable bond of scarce capital in its own vault before acting. Each answer is graded; one junk verdict burns a fixed slice of that identity's bond, and repeated failures spiral its remaining stake toward zero. A farm cannot share one vault across aliases, since each fake needs its own fresh bond; cannot parallelize, since slashing lands per identity; and cannot bulk-buy, because the locked capital is destroyed on bad grades, not rented. Honest agents keep their stake while sybils bleed a plume of forfeited collateral until farming costs more than it earns.
